description: Get a link the person can open to sign up for TIX email alerts about a show (deals and presales for it, plus offers in their state; free, unsubscribe any time). The link opens the sign-up on the TIX show page, where they enter their own email and confirm. Use it when someone wants to hear about a deal or presale for a show.

show.description: TIX show page URL (from search_shows), its slug, or the show name.

name: show_alert_link
title: Deal alert link for a show on TIX
